changes.title: Stump keep clear
items: Nothing special stands right by a stump or runestone any more: legend circles, giant mushrooms, ruins, walls, flasks, finds, ponds, campfires, picnics and playgrounds all keep 40 m away

changes.title: Shake and range
items: Screen shake from a hit stops after a moment, even in a legend's circle or on the treehouse deck, and a flurry of hits can't keep it going
Creatures' shots at you no longer fizzle out before they reach you: they fly as far as they're fired from

changes.title: Leyline boot dots
items: The ley line is drawn as its rainbow dots as soon as its tip comes off the home ring, not only once the boot is over
The boot's line round the home ring is drawn like the rest of the ley line: rainbow dots ahead of its pulse, the music's analyser behind it, and the same spark
The boot's ring and the ley line are one line: after its lap round the dancefloor the line carries on round the same way and sweeps off toward the first runestone, never doubling back the other way

changes.title: Stumps grounded
items: The great stumps lie on the ground at every camera angle, no longer floating as you zoom or fly
The music spell sits right in the middle of the stump's rings, and the soundsystem stands there too
The spell's analyser lies flat round the rings and fills the whole root area, its bars starting outside the music notes
When a wave brings the party to an area, its stump's analyser bursts out from the centre all at once as the soundsystem rises
A key hint (E, hold) by the music notes when you can cast

changes.title: Stump wisps
items: A wild stump's clearing is lit by eerie teal moonlight and a few blue, green and teal wisps drifting round it, not by its sigils' red glow; away from the party her own glow turns cool too, so the wild reads blue-green and the party warm

changes.title: Pins breathe
items: The morning's guide pins gently pulse until you cast the party spell

changes.title: Hat band capes
items: Her hats lie on the Cloakroom floor: walk up to one and press E to wear it, leaving the one she had on in its place
A new Band card at the mirror: one colour for the hat's glowing band and its plume
Short cloaks go down to the knee, long cloaks from the knee down
Cloak and scarf lengths are on their own cards
The cloak pegs stand in the Cloakroom's north-east corner, and last night's clothes lie in the middle of the bedroom

changes.title: Default look
items: Pause page (with the debug overlay or Unlock everything on): Copy look as defaults gives how she's dressed now as the game's default look, and Try as a new witch opens a tab playing as a brand-new witch, nothing saved

changes.title: Dj booth
items: Her decks are now a DJ booth: choose a record (100 to 200 BPM; you start with 100 and 120, find the rest in the forest), then Get this party started
The whole night plays at the record's tempo
The record shelf on the Terrace is gone
